question: Should an enabled Active Memory plugin with omitted `config.agents` automatically target every configured agent despite the shipped explicit-targeting contract and upgrade activation risk?
rationale: Source and tests establish the mechanics, but only the feature owner can choose whether omission means no targets or inherited targets for existing installations.

options.title: Keep Explicit Targeting
options.body: Preserve omission as no targets and solve setup friction by generating or repairing an explicit agent list.

options.title: Approve Inherited Targeting
options.body: Accept automatic activation for configured agents and require direct final-head upgrade and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Design Explicit All-Agents Mode
options.body: Pause this PR and define an intentional all-configured-agents contract without overloading field omission.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Targeting
recommendation.body: Preserve omission as no targets and solve setup friction by generating or repairing an explicit agent list.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available feature-history connection to Active Memory's runtime and configuration contract.
